enrichments.obs_text: The codes of considering are verbs of setting, turning and looking: H7760K and H7896K (to put, set; set mind to), H6437G (to turn), H7200H (to see, consider), H7878 (to muse), H7920 (to consider, contemplate), G2657 (to pay attention, contemplate, with intense attention) and G1760 (to reflect on). With them H3820A (heart) is the seat set on the matter, as in Job 1:8 and Pro 24:32. The lexicon bears out attention set on a matter and taken in. H0595 (I), H1934 (to be) and G3756 (not) are small words in the units of Pro 24:32, Dan 7:8 and Rom 4:19.

The codes of reckoning are H2803H and H2803J (to think, account, esteem, reckon), G3049 (to credit, count, reckon; regard), G2233 (to think, consider, count), G1380 (to think, consider, regard), H5234A (to regard, acknowledge), H5414I (to give, set, make) and H6188 (to count uncircumcised). The lexicon bears out counting a person or thing as something, as in Heb 11:26, Isa 29:16 and 1Sa 1:16.

The codes of having regard are verbs of looking and heeding: H8159 (to gaze, regard), H5027 (to look, regard), H7789 (to behold, regard), H7200G (to see, regard), H0995 (to discern, give heed), H6437G (to turn toward), H6485I (to pay attention to), H8104J (to keep, give heed), H7919A (to give attention to), H3045 (to know), and H5375Q (to lift the face, show favour). The lexicon bears out regard given or withheld, as in Gen 4:5 and 2Ki 3:14. H0408 and H3808 (not) and H0853 (the object marker) are small words in the units.
enrichments.grounds: to look at or to, regard

enrichments.obs_text: The codes of with regard to are prepositions and nouns of concern: G4012 (about, concerning, in regard to), G3313 (part, share), H1700 (cause, manner, reason) and H9006 (from). The lexicon bears out a linking phrase of respect in Judg 15:3, Ecc 3:18, Act 28:22 and Col 2:16, naming no act of thinking.

The codes of regarding by a standard are G6063 and G1097, verbs of knowing (to know, recognize, understand). The lexicon gives knowing, which 2Cor 5:16 uses for the rule by which a person is regarded.
enrichments.grounds: to know, come to know, recognize, understand

enrichments.obs_text: The codes of weighing in the mind are H0239 (weigh, test, prove, consider) and G1252 (to make a distinction, judge a dispute). The lexicon bears out testing and judging what is said or learned, in Ecc 12:9 and 1Cor 14:29.

The codes of weighing out are H8254 (to weigh, weigh out, pay out) and H5187 (laden). The lexicon bears out H8254 in Ezr 8:29; the lexicon of H5187 gives only laden, while Zep 1:11 renders it as weighing out silver: the data and the rendering differ.
enrichments.grounds: to weigh, weigh out, pay out

enrichments.obs_text: The code of weight is H4948 (heaviness, weight). The lexicon bears out a stated weight of an object in Gen 24:22, Jos 7:21 and Eze 5:1.
